rationale: Builds on the staged reverse-tail best by spending the terminal budget on training and the required exact int8+zlib score path only. The embedded script lowers the final reserve, skips the pre-save float validation pass, and removes the unused full-precision npz save so more wallclock can go to late quant-aware training while preserving VAL_LOSS_EVERY=0 and the final exact evaluation.
title: Reserve-Reclaimed Exact-Only Endgame
